database.name: HefnoPlant Nematicides Active Ingredients Database
database.description: Scientific database of agricultural nematicide active ingredients — chemical, biological, and botanical — classified by mode-of-action group, with target nematode-species and crop relationships, resistance risk/cross-reactivity, and IPM guidance. Active-ingredient-first: no commercial/trade product names, brands, or prices are included.
database.scope: Nematicide active ingredients only (agricultural plant-parasitic nematode control in Egypt / the Arab region).
